core_obligations: Variable (proof lines 501-502): rule bredpar1 gives M = M' = x, and x bred x.
Abstraction (lines 503-507): rule bredpar2; the induction hypothesis N bred N' lifts to lambda x.N bred lambda x.N' by running the same sequence of contractions under the binder.
Application (lines 508-512): rule bredpar3; concatenate the sequence from P bred P' with the one from Q bred Q' to obtain PQ bred P'Q'.
Redex (lines 513-520): rule bredpar4; from N bred N' and Q bred Q' reduce the abstraction, then the argument, then contract the resulting single redex.
proof_roadmap: Invert on the last derivation rule of M bredpar M'.
Lift sequences through binders and application contexts.
For a contracted redex reduce the two sides first, then perform the single step.
difficulty_reason: The easy half of the equivalence between parallel and sequential beta-reduction (statement 490-492, proof 494-521): a four-case derivation induction where every case is written out with the reduction sequence it builds. No delegated cases and no omissions. H2: routine concatenation bookkeeping.
